== Strategy ==

Strategy:
Playing This Deck Is very simple just deploy your Jedi And drain your opponent. Combo Higher Ground / Smoke Screen is very handy in battle you draw 7 for destiny and  opponent draw’s nonJ use jedi concentration to prevent your jedi  from beaing chopped to pices bu Maul or VaderJ
